csv_scope_of_work: Engineering services for developing comprehensive technical specifications regarding structural, concrete, and coating repairs at Joker Marchant Stadium located at 2301 Lakeland Hills Blvd, Lakeland, FL 33805. This structure is multi-level stadium constructed primarily on precast and cast-in place concrete elements. The upper-level addition is constructed utilizing steel girders, beams and columns, including concrete slabs placed over composite metal decking. The walking surface of the stadium seating area and the exterior deck areas are coated with a liquid membrane waterproof coating.
